tips.text: Roll for Skill Effect % and Boss DMG %. ATK % is not worth it on potentials.
Skill Effect does not boost passives or summons, so it is wasted on summoners like Violet.
Crit chance maxes at 50%. Stop investing in it once you reach that and move to Crit DMG.
Offline rewards are small; you progress much faster farming while online.
Resets are free, so keep a boss setup and a farming setup (Wisdom and Platinum) and switch as needed.
Convert surplus Unique, Epic and Legend heroes into Stardust, and push Fortress Expansion tiers for 30 Stardust each.
For bosses take ATK first, then Skill Effect and Boss DMG, then Crit DMG. For farming take Gold, then EXP.
Burst Cannon for farming. Freeze Cannon does nothing against X-20 bosses.
Check the compass icon by the stage number at 03, 09, 15 and 21 UTC. Gandalfu and Queen Slime are the ones with an ATK multiplier.
Past stage 50 you need the Red Barrier Kit and Zelos with his exclusive weapon.

steps.text: Get Repair Cat (2-10) and start Merfolk's Ambush (2-11).
Open constellations at 5-10 and level Libra (Thorn Blade, Stepping Stone for onboard heroes).
Build crit chance up to the 50% maximum.
Farm actively instead of relying on offline rewards.
Invest 15 nebula levels to open Leonis and 30 to open Aquaril (Gold Knife for Legend heroes).
Reroll potentials toward Skill Effect % and Boss DMG %.
Check gear rolls against the Legend ranges on the Gear page before upgrading.
Pair a buffer (Gildong or Ruingaladh) with your main dealer; both are multipliers in the damage formula.
Equip the Red Barrier Kit and run Zelos with his exclusive weapon.
Machina Engineering opens after 50-20; craft Precision Parts from Blueprints.
Scorpii (120 levels) brings Iron Gate for Fortress HP.
The drafts' "Fortress HP pivot" (HP% engines, engine slot 2 at Augmentation 5) is not backed by any source.
